hooks.name: Protect critical config files
hooks.description: Prompts for extra scrutiny before modifying infrastructure and config files

action.prompt: You are about to modify a file. If this file is a critical configuration file (vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, template.yaml, samconfig.toml, deploy.sh, deploy.ps1, or infrastructure/*.yaml), please verify: 1) The change is intentional and necessary, 2) It won't break the build or deployment pipeline, 3) The existing functionality is preserved. Proceed only if you're confident the change is safe.
